name: Example: Integrating Using Arcsecant
worked_solution:
Recall that

$$
\int \dfrac{1}{|x|\sqrt{x^2 - 1}} \, \textrm dx = \textrm{arcsec} \, x.
$$

Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}f(x) & =\int {f}^{′}(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int (\frac{5}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}-2x)\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{5}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}\,\text{d}x-\int 2x\,\text{d}x \\  & =5\int \frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}\,\text{d}x-2\int x\,\text{d}x \\  & =5\text{arcsec}\,(x)-2\cdot \frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+C \\  & =5\text{arcsec}\,(x)-{x}^{2}+C.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
